description: This Dart source file defines state management and provider logic for user profile features in a Flutter application. It includes state class definitions, providers for repositories and controllers, and methods for loading and creating user profiles, utilizing Riverpod for state management and Dio for network requests.

classes.name: ProfileState
classes.description: Immutable class representing the profile UI state, including patient data, loading status, submitting status, and error message.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile from the backend and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with provided information and updates state.

methods.name: _friendlyError
methods.description: Converts exceptions into user-friendly error messages.
